annotations.title: Find accessible pull requests to link

description: Search accessible GitHub pull requests for this finding. Defaults to the finding's repository, otherwise its connected GitHub organisation. Results are advisory; link_finding_pull_request verifies the chosen PR. Requires read permission and a configured GitHub integration.

findingId.description: Raw internal finding ID, useful when chaining from another tool.

identifier.description: Human-readable finding identifier such as "ODI-12". Preferred input.

query.description: PR number, title search, owner/repo#123, or GitHub PR URL.

name: list_finding_pull_requests
title: Find accessible pull requests to link
